Delivery access is limited to %1$d km from the destination. Routing uses the shortest route and preserves height, width, length, gross and axle weight, ADR and turn restrictions. Destination and delivery tagged sections are admitted only under their own conditions; private property needs the per-trip permission above because map data cannot prove it. Unknown limits, barriers and bridges on restricted access require verification; affected sections may remain in the route with a warning. The declaration applies to this trip on this device.

Only recorded roads, addresses and places can be found. Missing search results do not mean a place or truck entrance is absent on the ground. Truck entrances and final access are not verified by this map. The bounds are a data extent, not proof of complete coverage or legal access.
Only the selected map is active. Cross-border routes, truck-law coverage and time-dependent restrictions remain incomplete. Check road signs.

Made by drivers, for drivers. Free, open source, local navigation.

MIT code. OSM maps: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. No accounts, subscriptions or analytics. Internet is used to download maps; routes, roads, search and GPS run on the device.

No maps are bundled. Romania is the first test country. Europe excluding Russia is the coverage target; publication of all country packages and seamless cross-border routing are pending.

This development build has not passed road validation. Mapped ADR load types and B–E tunnel codes are checked. Country truck laws, conditional restrictions and complete ADR rules need further work. Offline voice needs an installed voice.

Android 8+ minimum; Tab S9 checks and Android 8/17 emulator tests are recorded in VERIFICATION.md. Road validation and low-end hardware tests remain necessary.
